verdict.rationale: Jan exposes an OpenAI-compatible local API (localhost:1337) for chat/model inference, but there's no evidence that UI-only features like managing custom assistants, MCP configuration, or model downloads are exposed via API — and probes for an OpenAPI spec/docs returned 404, suggesting no comprehensive API surface parity is documented. missing for 10: documented API endpoints for assistants/MCP/model management, published OpenAPI spec, independent confirmation of API-UI parity.
